recent.text: The Hawks had 24 offensive rebounds today against the Pistons. That is the most for the team since November 6, 2023. Quin Snyder noted postgame that what Dyson Daniels has been able to do in that area is unique for a perimeter player, and he led the team with 7 OREB.
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.text: This is the first time Cade Cunningham finished a game with 5 points or fewer since January 7, 2024, and he only played 11 minutes in that game. First time he scored 5 or less in a full workload since December 15, 2023.
recent.author: Brad Rowland
recent.quoted_text: The Hawks have won 4 straight and this one gets a big hat-tip to the bench. +18 or better for Dort, Wiggins, Ejiofor, Kispert. That group (+ Dyson) led a huge run to start Q4 that put Atlanta in control. Hawks also dominated glass + possession battle. @LockedOnHawks to come.

recent.text: Final: Hawks 107, Pistons 97 Daniels: 2 blocks short of a 5x5 Dort: 16 pts, 7 reb Kispert: 18 pts Alexander-Walker: 27 pts
